experiment.title: LSEG-33 structured anticipated-reaction sentiment score
experiment.objective: Test whether a direct, structured sentiment score representing the anticipated first tradable stock-price reaction creates economic value on the LSEG-33 Reuters company-session set.

researcher_instruction.request: Use every structured assessment except whether the headline is new, because the model cannot know that.
included_steps: better, worse, or unclear versus expectations
anticipated down, flat or unclear, or up first tradable reaction
final directional sentiment score from -1 to +1
researcher_instruction.reason: The model cannot reliably know novelty from a single headline.

authorisation_and_privacy.payload: selected current Reuters headline plus target-company name and symbol only
authorisation_and_privacy.route: OpenRouter to DeepInfra only; Gemma 4 26B FP8; no fallback; ZDR requested; provider data collection denied
authorisation_and_privacy.authoritative_cost: sum of reported_cost_usd over append-only attempt rows

population.universe: same 33 LSEG companies; Reuters NS:RTRS only
population.filters: explicit target, non-market-price/technical, one original-33 company, first story-family release
population.spacing: one deterministic headline per company and first executable XNYS session
population.entry_timing: first XNYS open at least 15 minutes after availability
population.invalid_outputs: Never coerce or impute; make at most one cleanup pass and use strict successes only.

model_and_prompt.score_meaning: Directional conviction about the first tradable stock reaction; not a percentage return.
model_and_prompt.trade_signal: reaction_score when target_specific is true; otherwise zero

chronology_and_economics.portfolio: one strongest positive and one strongest negative company per formation session, plus 0.5 and minus 0.5, held for one session
chronology_and_economics.comparators: existing Gemma and FinBERT polarity ranks on the reaction prompt's exact formation dates and exposure
selection_gate: 2024 gross and net means are positive
2024 break-even is at least 10 bps per side
2024 net mean is positive in at least three of four quarters
2024 net mean beats same-date Gemma in at least three of four quarters
2024 net mean beats same-date FinBERT in at least three of four quarters
chronology_and_economics.failed_selection_action: Do not compute a 2025 reaction-score portfolio.
chronology_and_economics.inference: paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 10-session blocks, 9999 replications; Benjamini-Hochberg across three tests

claim_boundaries: The prompt was designed after Notebook 83's five prompt outcomes were known.
The 2024-2025 LSEG dates are retrospectively explored elsewhere in the project.
A positive result would be iterative evidence, not independent confirmation or validated alpha.
A null rejects this structured prompt construction, not every possible anticipated-reaction prompt.
No further wording, schema, score-grid, horizon, cost, universe or portfolio change is allowed after new scores are opened.
